Name: Abhra (MR-SAM)
Notes: Status: In service. MR-SAM is a medium range air defence system with a max range of 70–80 km. It is used to counter aerial threats such as Fighter aircraft, helicopter, UAV etc.

Name: Akash
Notes: Status: In service. Akash 1S has 40 km operational range and flight ceiling of 20 km. 2 regiments of Akash Prime on order for Army. Akash-NG with increased range of 70–80 km being tested.

Name: Anant Shastra (QRSAM)
Notes: Status: In service. Used in limited numbers.

Name: 9K33 Osa (SA-8 Gecko)
Notes: Status: In service (Phasing out). To be replaced by QRSAM.[circular reference]

Name: S-125 (SA-3 Goa)
Notes: Status: In service (Phasing out). To be replaced by Akash. Used for point-defense of airbases.

Name: Kub (SA-6 Gainful)
Notes: Status: In service (Phasing out) To be replaced by Akash. Used by 501 and 502 AD Group of Army as of 2012

Name: 9K35 Strela-10 (SA-13 Gopher)
Notes: Status: In service Currently under upgradation with indigenous EO systems and the 9M333 missiles.
